| `PS2_VK_CENSUS_AB` | off | N frames | [measurement] With PS2_VK_CENSUS: frames counted only in odd blocks of N frames (PS2_THREAD_PROF event 24 marks the blocks): `tools/perf/frame_timeline.py PREFIX --census-ab` gives the census' own recording cost as the paired block difference +- its standard error | @@PS2_VK_CENSUS_AB@@ |
| `PS2_LOG_STAMP` | off | `1` | [diagnostic] Every log line starts with `[unix seconds fFIELD] ` (CLOCK_REALTIME to 0.1 ms, the clock of PS2_GPU_TRACE's t_unix; the GS field counter); the first line gives `realtime - monotonic` for PS2_THREAD_PROF's clock. | `ACZ_UPDATE_CHECK` | unset: `[update] check` of the settings file, default 1 | `0`, `1` | (setup_1105; `docs/SETTINGS.md` "Updates") `ac0vr.exe` asks the latest release at start (WinHTTP, 3 s; offline or rate-limited: silent). `0`: no question at start; the window's button still asks | (`tools/setup/ac0vr_update.c`) |
| `ACZ_UPDATE_URL` | the public repository's `releases/latest` | a URL; `file:///` works | [test] (setup_1105) `ac0vr.exe`: another JSON of that shape, for a mock release | (`tools/setup/ac0vr_update.c`) |
| `ACZ_CRASH_REPORT` | `1` | `0`/`1` | On a crash (an unhandled exception, abort()): a minidump (dbghelp, without heaps and module paths) and a text report with the last 200 log lines in `crash/` next to the exe (`%TEMP%\ac5_crash` when that folder cannot be written); the next start logs where the newest report is and keeps the 8 newest. Nothing is written without a crash and nothing is ever sent. `ps2_fatal_report()` writes the same text report without a dump for fatal conditions that are not exceptions (ps2_fatal calls it; the stall exit and a lost GPU device are the next, stab_audit U5, U8). `0`: only the log lines as before. Costs one sleeping thread and a memcpy per log line (night_setup 2026-11-04). Linux / Android (quest_port 2026-11-07): no minidump; a handler for SIGSEGV, SIGBUS, SIGILL, SIGFPE, SIGTRAP and SIGABRT writes the signal, fault address, thread, PC / LR / SP and a frame-pointer walk (library + offset via dladdr) into the log and `crash.txt` (with the last 200 log lines) in the start folder (the app's files folder), then re-raises for the system's tombstone (`adb logcat -b crash`); the next start logs it and renames it `crash_prev.txt`. ACZ_CRASH_TEST works there too | @@ACZ_CRASH_REPORT@@ |
| `PS2_LOG_IMAGES` | off | `1` | [diagnostic] Log every image the renderer makes (size, format, layers, samples, MB, field) and which render target / snapshot it is for (ov_hitch: what a hitch frame created) | @@PS2_LOG_IMAGES@@ |
| `PS2_CPU_PROF` | off | `1` | [diagnostic] CPU zones on the host threads (ov_cpu 2026-10-25, runtime/include/ps2_cpuprof.h): every instance of a zone is timed by TSC -- renderer: pump events (SDL, pad, rumble, Touch) and its Touch sync, fence + GPU times, prefill, pre-upload, xrWaitFrame + xrBeginFrame, recording after the wait and its render_list, early recording, final submit + xrEndFrame, window present, pipeline warm-up step / cache save, idle, the whole attempt; graphics worker (and stage 2) busy per field and the display-list hand-off; the EE's work per field; the audio callback and its game / immersion / cockpit-system layers; the cracks worker; and every guest hook as `ee hook OWNER before/after/replace ADDR` (trails sampler, props, syssnd, gaze, VR camera, ...). With PS2_SPEED_LOG every 5 s one `cpu:` line per zone (calls and ms per field, mean, p50, p99, max, instances over the spike threshold; the 16 costliest hooks) and `cpu: spike` lines; with PS2_THREAD_PROF every instance of at least PS2_CPU_PROF_TL_US as timeline event 20 (a = zone, b = ns, c = thread id; names in `<path>.zones`). `tools/perf/cpu_timeline.py zones LOG` / `ab TP.csv --ab 12\|15\|16` / `svg TP.csv OUT.svg --at S --span MS` (thread lanes). Off: one predictable branch per zone | @@PS2_CPU_PROF@@ |
| `PS2_CPU_PROF_SPIKE_US` | `1000` | microseconds | [diagnostic] With PS2_CPU_PROF: an instance longer than this counts as a spike (`over`; per-field zones: over 16.7 ms; waits never) | @@PS2_CPU_PROF_SPIKE_US@@ |
| `PS2_CPU_PROF_TL_US` | `20` | microseconds | [diagnostic] With PS2_CPU_PROF and PS2_THREAD_PROF: zone instances at least this long go into the timeline | @@PS2_CPU_PROF_TL_US@@ |

| `PS2_CPU_AB_FLIP` | none | comma list: `pause`, `vif`, `policy`, `idle`, `pool`, `bell`, `prio` | [test] Which switches PS2_CPU_AB alternates: `pause` = PS2_PERF_EE_PAUSE (8 when unset); `vif` = PS2_PERF_VIF_FAST (the word path in the A blocks; checked every 64 VIF chunks); `policy` = the spin-free thread policy (PS2_THREAD_POLICY) whatever P is: `idle` the EE idle wait, `pool` the pool's helpers and spin, `bell` PS2_GFXQ_DOORBELL, `prio` PS2_THREAD_POLICY_PRIO -- the policy's values in the B blocks, the old ones in the A blocks, switched at fields, with a `cpu-ab:` log line per block (CPU per field of every thread role and of the process, EE idle waits, vblank wake latency, stage 1 wake-ups, the EE's signals; `tools/perf/tpol_ab.py LOG TP.csv --from-field F` pairs the blocks and prints the vblank -> list chain) | @@PS2_CPU_AB_FLIP@@ |

With a list (ov_cpu 2026-10-25) the 1 ms sampler visits the threads in turn and each writes PS2_PROFILE_HOST_OUT with `.<thread>` before the extension | @@PS2_PROFILE_HOST@@ |

| `PS2_TEX_DETAIL` | off | any | Texture census with per-texture alpha details (arms diagnostics) | @@PS2_TEX_DETAIL@@ |
| `PS2_TEX_LOG` | off | any | Log texture slot counts as they grow | @@PS2_TEX_LOG@@ |
| `PS2_TEX_STREAM_LOG` | off | N fields (`1` = 600) | [diagnostic] Every N fields `tex-stream:` lines: the graphics worker's CPU per field (thread cycles; mean, max, fields over 12 / 16.7 ms; the PS2_PERF_TEX_AB block), TSC time per field of texture cache lookups, memo keys, decodes (count, Mtexel), the store, native regions and image transfers (MB, stream sizes, share on the PSMT8 fast path, PSMT4 MB and its share on the four-row path); decoded contents seen before (by distance in fields); native-region hashing / source-key hits / stores; direct decodes, the pool's share and its helpers' decode / spin time; partial decodes (PS2_PERF_TEX_PARTIAL: share of pages kept, texels not decoded, verify counts); decodes on demand (PS2_PERF_TEX_LAZY: texels put off, made later for draws / for native regions and their ms, never made, verify counts; the decodes zone includes the demands); native regions split into the upload-records path and the GS-decode path (count, ms, PS2_PERF_REGION_MEMO hits / misses and ns per hit / full lookup); the records path's fresh record hashes (KB, ms), fills and stores. gsreplay: one set of lines per pass instead (stage 2's thread cycles per field; with PS2_REPLAY_TEX_AB the pass's block) | @@PS2_TEX_STREAM_LOG@@ |

| `PS2_PERF_AB_FLIP` | `mono,dry` | comma list of `mono`, `dry`, `pmask`, `sparse`, `reuse`, `cpidx`, `terrain`, `gshadow`, `optics`, `hudglass`, `depthcut`, `markersharp`, `markershape`, `markerlines`, `cpinner`, `unify`, `eaa`, `cloudfx`, `cloudedge`, `props`, `vrs`, `dyn`, `water`, `msaa2`, `tmat`, `glass`, `flash`, `expo`, `cracks`, `behindz`, `texpack`, `wet`, `gov1`..`gov8`, `govseq`, `mirrors`, `mirclouds`, `mirlive`, `mirreal`, `mirtone`, `datequad`, `datebatch`, `datehf`, `scenelight`, `glassspec`, `nreuse`, `offrt`, `cutpre`, `freshhead`, `fogr`, `compunroll`, `cpspec`, `gssplit`, `wxonce`, `waterexit`, `dust`, `noglass`, `soot`, `nightpanel`, `drops`, `cloudwake`, `fxsoft`, `layers`, `rime`, `cloudsplit`, `shafts`, `compearly`, `cloudsoft`, `citylook`, `burst`, `tunnel`, `dynstate`, `cpfold`, `cvrs`, `cptex`, `cvrsdry`, `dsplit`, `lwcpit`, `gxv`, `gwsnap`, `cplod1`, `cplod2`, `cptexb`, `cdmed`, `cdlow`, `nearspec`, `clouddetail`, `terrzc`, `cqmed`, `cqlow`, `cqa`..`cqd`, `fgrp`, `fgself`, `fghoist`, `fgkeep`, `fg`, `rnbatch`, `white`, `cpk` | [test] Which switches PS2_PERF_AB=1 flips: PS2_PERF_MONO_TARGETS, PS2_PERF_CANOPY_DRY, ACZ_VR_COCKPIT_INDEXED (`cpidx` keeps the old vertex buffer too), the realistic terrain relief (`terrain`: an exact image A/B of the same frame), cloud shadows on the ground (`gshadow`: the same, except the tree sprites, whose colour the game frame carries); `optics`: the optical phenomena (ACZ_VR_OPTICS) off in the re-draw -- since 2026-10-21 the re-draws keep their own cloud pass slots, so our clouds are re-drawn faithfully (before, every re-draw read the last re-draw's cloud uniforms); `hudglass`: the HUD's combiner mark left out (ACZ_VR_HUD_GLASS), `depthcut`: the cockpit depth without the alpha cut (ACZ_VR_COCKPIT_DEPTH_CUT); `markersharp`: target boxes from the smooth replacement (ACZ_VR_MARKER_SHARP); `markershape`: target boxes flat (ACZ_VR_MARKER_SHARP=1); `markerlines`: target boxes as shapes (ACZ_VR_MARKER_SHARP=2 instead of 3); `cpinner`: the canopy weather on every glass over 0.12 m as before ACZ_VR_CANOPY_INNER (water, mist, film, ice, grime, flecks; not fx_glass's wear); `unify`: in-between frames with unmatched native meshes on the old screen-space path (PS2_XR_REPROJ_UNIFY); `eaa`: edge AA (PS2_EDGE_AA) off in the re-draw (same-frame A/B of its softening); `cloudfx`: ACZ_VR_CLOUD_FX flipped (the composite's place before the effect sprites and the effect depth stamp); `cloudedge`: ACZ_VR_CLOUD_EDGE_DEPTH flipped; `vrs`: the re-draw without the foveated shading attachment (PS2_VRS_FOV; with PS2_VRS_FOV_DUMP_CROP=1 for the crop); `dyn`: the re-draw with static blend pipelines (PS2_PERF_DYN_BLEND); `water`: the shader water (ACZ_TERRAIN_WATER) left out of the re-draw (the same frame and wave time); `msaa2`: the cockpit model at the other sample count (4x <-> the governor's 2x level 3; since nx_cpit also with the governor off, and 2x -> 4x for a model of ACZ_VR_COCKPIT_MSAA_AUTO); `cutpre`: the re-draw with the cut parts drawn the other way (ACZ_VR_COCKPIT_CUT_PREPASS); `fogr`: the re-draw with ACZ_VR_FOG_RADIAL flipped (the world meshes' fog and the horizon haze ring's layers) (hz_m2 2026-10-26); `tmat`: the near-ground materials (ACZ_TERRAIN_MATERIALS) left out of the re-draw; `glass`: the canopy glass effects (ACZ_VR_CANOPY_SCRATCH / _GLARE / _REFLECT) left out of the re-draw; `flash`: the flash lights (ACZ_VR_FLASH_LIGHT) off in the re-draw (the cockpit by the light block index's 0.5 flag, the clouds by their own pass slots); `expo`: the eye adaptation's exposure pass left out (ACZ_VR_EYE_ADAPT); `cracks`: the canopy cracks (ACZ_VR_CANOPY_CRACKS) left out of the re-draw; `behindz`: PS2_MESH_BEHIND_Z flipped in the re-draw (native mesh depth behind the eye); `texpack`: the T5 terrain pack (ACZ_TERRAIN_TEXPACK) left out of the re-draw (the 2006 texture); `wet`: the canopy weather (water, mist, film, ice, flecks: ACZ_VR_CANOPY) left out of the re-draw (ov_visual 2026-10-25); `gov1`..`gov8`: the re-draw sheds the frame-time governor's levels 1..N fully (the look of a level; the materials' shedding and the terrain detail ring are made on the game side, so the re-draw shows them only fully off resp. not at all); `govseq`: the 1st dumped frame's re-draw sheds level 1, the 2nd levels 1-2, ... in turn (logged `perf-ab: dump k`) (ov_gov 2026-10-25); `nightpanel`: the night instrument lighting (ACZ_VR_COCKPIT_NIGHT_LIGHTS, bug #197) left out of the re-draw; `pmask`: PS2_PASS_MASK off in the re-draw (with PS2_PASS_MASK_DUMP=1); `sparse`: ACZ_VR_CLOUD_NEAR_FOV_DEG off in the re-draw; `reuse`: PS2_XR_INBETWEEN_REUSE off in the re-draw (an in-between dump frame: PS2_XR_DUMP_RERENDER=1); `mirrors`: the cockpit's rear-view mirrors as before (ACZ_VR_COCKPIT_MIRRORS) in the re-draw; `mirclouds`: the rear-view mirrors without our clouds (ACZ_VR_COCKPIT_MIRRORS_CLOUDS) in the re-draw; `datequad`: alpha-writing flat native DATE draws back on their snapshot copies (PS2_DATE_LOCAL_QUAD); `datebatch`: the re-draw with PS2_DATE_BATCH=0 (the game's draw order, one feedback barrier per tile); `datehf`: alpha-writing heightfield DATE meshes back on their snapshot copies (PS2_DATE_LOCAL_HF) (nx_date 2026-10-25); `nreuse`: an in-between frame's near clouds marched in full in the re-draw (ACZ_VR_CLOUD_NEAR_REUSE; dump in-between frames with PS2_XR_DUMP_RERENDER=1) (nx_cloudreuse 2026-10-25); `scenelight`: the 3D cockpit lit by the game's model lights as before (ACZ_VR_COCKPIT_SCENE_LIGHT off in the re-draw); `glassspec`: the canopy glass's sun highlight as the material's broad lobe (ACZ_VR_COCKPIT_GLASS_SHINE=0) (ov_light 2026-10-25); `offrt`: the re-draw with the governor's offrt lever shed (the qualifying off-screen targets at ACZ_VR_GOV_OFFRT_SCALE) (nx_offscreen 2026-10-25); `freshhead`: the 3D cockpit drawn the other way of ACZ_VR_COCKPIT_FRESH_HEAD (the game frame's eye position instead of the newest, or back) (lb_f15 2026-10-26); `compunroll`, `cpspec`, `gssplit`: the re-draw with ACZ_VR_CLOUD_COMP_UNROLL, ACZ_VR_COCKPIT_SHADER_SPLIT, PS2_PERF_GS_SPLIT the other way (fq_opt 2026-10-26; the other pipelines are made when the flip names them); `wxonce`: the canopy weather on every shell of a multi-shell canopy as before ACZ_VR_CANOPY_WX_ONCE; `waterexit`: the canopy water state of the other model (ACZ_IMM_WATER_EXIT); `dust`: the sunlit dust (ACZ_VR_CANOPY_DUST) left out; `noglass`: the 3D cockpit's glass pass left out (how much the canopy shows at all); `soot`: the soot film (ACZ_IMM_SOOT) left out (cv_canopy 2026-10-27); `drops`: the canopy drops in the other look of ACZ_VR_CANOPY_DROPS (cv_drops 2026-10-29); `cloudwake`: the cloud wake's strips left out (ACZ_VR_CLOUD_WAKE; cl_wake 2026-10-29); `fxsoft`: the effects' soft depth edges left out (ACZ_VR_FX_SOFT; fx_boom 2026-10-29); `mirtone`: with LIVE or SKY the mirrors as TONE in the re-draw (ACZ_VR_COCKPIT_MIRRORS_TONE_AB); `mirreal`: the mirrors' parts behind the pilot by the cube march instead of the real view (ACZ_VR_COCKPIT_MIRRORS_REAL; mir_sharp 2026-10-29); `layers`: the canopy's outside weather on the glass mesh as before ACZ_VR_CANOPY_LAYERS; `rime`: the frost in the other look of ACZ_VR_CANOPY_RIME (rain_layers 2026-10-30); `cloudsplit`: our far cloud composite by the cloud's mean distance as before (ACZ_VR_CLOUD_FAR_SPLIT; cl_split 2026-10-30); `shafts`: the light shafts in the haze the other way (ACZ_VR_CLOUD_SHAFTS); `compearly`: the far composite without its early exit (ACZ_VR_CLOUD_COMP_EARLY); `cloudsoft`: the effects' cloud veil the other way (ACZ_VR_CLOUD_FX_SOFT: off = the binary stamp; fx_mpbm 2026-10-31); `citylook`: the city buildings in the plain look as before (ACZ_TERRAIN_CITY_LOOK; houses 2026-10-31); `tunnel`: the re-draw as under an open sky (ACZ_VR_TUNNEL_LIGHT; exact for the cockpit's solid parts, which take it by push constant; the glass, the mirrors and the scene light's bounce read the frame's shared blocks, so compare ACZ_VR_TUNNEL_LIGHT=0 runs for them) (tunnel_light 2026-11-02); `burst`: the MPBM burst's volume left out (ACZ_VR_FX_BURST; the game's glow stays hidden: ACZ_VR_FX_BURST_HIDE; fx_burst 2026-11-02); `layered`: an in-between frame re-drawn the other way of ACZ_VR_SMOOTH_MODE (layered <-> rerender; the game frames' re-draws keep the copy; PS2_PERF_AB=1 with PS2_XR_DUMP_SEQ / _PAIR=1: the plain image of an in-between frame is one mode, its _nc image the other; perf4_smooth 2026-11-03); `dynstate`: the re-draw without PS2_PERF_DYN_STATE (PS2_PERF_DYN_BLEND alone); `cpfold`: the re-draw with the cockpit's multisampled pass in place (PS2_PERF_COCKPIT_FOLD) (perf4_passes 2026-11-03); `dsplit`: the re-draw issues every native-mesh triangle draw as two draws of its halves (the exact check that a draw boundary changes no pixel; `perf-ab: dsplit re-draw:` counts them: M3 2x, 2,032-2,181 draws split, game frames 6 of 6 eye images byte-identical; perf5_merge 2026-11-03); `lwcpit`: an in-between frame's re-draw draws the 3D cockpit when the frame kept the game frame's cockpit layer, or keeps it when the frame drew it (ACZ_VR_SMOOTH_LAYER_COCKPIT; dump in-between frames with PS2_XR_DUMP_RERENDER=1) (perf5_reproj 2026-11-03); `gxv`: the re-draw with the plain glass pipeline (PS2_PERF_GLASS_VARIANTS), `gwsnap`: with the canopy's world snapshot copy (PS2_PERF_CANOPY_INPLACE); the canopy's water, ice, film and flecks hold still between a dumped frame's re-draws, so the A/B is exact with them on (perf5_glassexact 2026-11-03); `cplod1` / `cplod2`: the re-draw draws the 3D cockpit at mesh LOD level 1 / 2 (ACZ_VR_COCKPIT_LOD), `cptexb`: through the texture twins of ACZ_VR_COCKPIT_AB_TEX_BUDGET, `cdmed` / `cdlow`: at that level of ACZ_VR_COCKPIT_DETAIL whole (perf6_cockpitladder 2026-11-04); `cvrsdry`: the re-draw with ACZ_VR_COCKPIT_VRS_DRY's gate the other way (the canopy's state and the gate are the frame's own in both re-draws; perf5_glasszones 2026-11-03); `nearspec`: the re-draw with the near cloud march's generic pipeline (ACZ_VR_CLOUD_NEAR_SPEC 0, as before; perf6_clouds 2026-11-03); `clouddetail`: the same frame re-drawn at another CLOUD DETAIL level: with ACZ_VR_CLOUD_DETAIL_AB_SET set the k-th dumped game frame's _nc images at its k-th entry in turn, else at HIGH (the plain images at the configured ACZ_VR_CLOUD_DETAIL; the rungs' look, same frame); `terrzc`: the re-draw as before PS2_PERF_TERRAIN_ZCULL (mesh.vert itself, no marks; perf5_terrain 2026-11-04); `cqmed` / `cqlow` / `cqa`..`cqd`: the same frame's glass with that CANOPY QUALITY set (ACZ_VR_CANOPY_QUALITY; `fgkeep` (S2b): the re-draw switches the target layouts at every target as before; `rnbatch`: the re-draw without PS2_RN_BATCH (every native-mesh draw on its own, the order as the game sends it: the exact check of the batches and the pass-major runs; | `PS2_XR_DEPTH` | off | `on`, `auto` (`1`, `2`) | Frame depth to the headset (xr_depth, 2026-10-23; the user's idea #1): XR_KHR_composition_layer_depth on the stereo projection layer, so the compositor's reprojection (positional timewarp; ASW 2.0 on the Meta PC runtime) moves near things with the head's translation, not only its rotation -- the 3D cockpit is 0.24-1.15 m from the eye, and every in-between frame (smooth mode) and every late or repeated frame is shown with a head pose 8-25 ms old. Per eye a D32 depth swapchain the size of the colour chain; each synchronous stereo frame (game and in-between frames) copies the frame depth's visible region (both eyes' crops) right before the game's last full-screen depth-writing pass (it leaves 1.0 everywhere by the eye copies) and converts it in a depth-only pass into one reversed mapping -- the 3D cockpit's 1 - 0.0002 per metre, the HUD combiner's mark, the sky and saturated 2D overlays at infinity, the world through the frame's own projection -- over the same pixels and crop as the colour (edges within half a pixel). No work and no depth for the head-locked image (stick head look outside the cockpit); no depth while the quit prompt / settings quad is up (Link depth-tests quads against it) or when an eye's colour went out without its depth. `on`: whenever the runtime offers the extension (the OpenXR Simulator does, and ignores it); `auto`: only on the Meta / Oculus PC runtime. GPU +0.10..+0.13 ms per stereo frame at 4x (simulator, user config, in-run PS2_XR_DEPTH_AB=60, 2 runs each: M3 J35J +0.099 / +0.129 and +0.101 / +0.127, M4 F-1 +0.102 / +0.107 and +0.101 / +0.108 per 40-block window; memory bandwidth of the copy and the pass over each eye's crop; ~0.2 ms expected on the headset path); memory at 4x 2 x 3 runtime images 2048x2048 D32 (~100 MB) + a 28 MB snapshot (2x: ~34 + 7 MB). | `PS2_PERF_TRX_T4_AB` | off | seconds | [diagnostic] In-run A/B of PS2_PERF_TRX_T4: the four-row PSMT4 path in odd blocks of that many seconds, the per-texel path in the even ones (taken at a field's first transfer; PS2_THREAD_PROF event 30 a = block, b = 1 four-row path; `tools/perf/cpu_timeline.py ab TP.csv --ab 30`: stage 2 busy per field A / B with standard errors) | @@PS2_PERF_TRX_T4_AB@@ |

| `PS2_PERF_TEX_DIRECT_VERIFY` | off | `1` | [debug] Every direct decode (PS2_PERF_TEX_DIRECT) is decoded the old way as well and compared (`gs: direct decodes verified N, M differ`) | @@PS2_PERF_TEX_DIRECT_VERIFY@@ |

## Quest standalone build (aczquest)

The arm64 APK of the Quest build (NOTES_QUEST.md; `tools/quest/build_game.sh`). On the headset there is no shell to export variables: `android_main` (`runtime/src/android/ps2_android.c`) applies `/sdcard/ac0oculus/commandline.txt` (the data root; `ACZQ_DATA` moves it), then `/sdcard/ac0oculus/scripts/<name>.txt` for `adb shell am start ... --es script <name>`, as environment variables before the runtime reads any: one `KEY=VALUE` per line, `#` starts a comment, and the key `ARGS` carries extra command-line arguments of the runtime (e.g. `ARGS=--vblanks 2520` ends the run by itself after 42 s; `--data`, `--disc` and `--watchdog 0` are added unless given). So every switch of this reference works on the headset unchanged. Before the file, the headset run's defaults are set (a value in the file wins): `PS2_XR=1`, `PS2_XR_MODE=stereo`, `PS2_XR_MULTIVIEW=1`, `PS2_VK_HEADLESS=1`, `ACZ_LAUNCHER=0`, `ACZ_TELEMETRY=off`, `ACZ_STATS=0`, `ACZ_TEX_DIR=<data root>/textures` when that folder exists. The process works in the app's files dir (`/sdcard/Android/data/com.kulakovri.ac0oculus/files/`): saves, `ac5_settings.ini`, `out/` dumps, `aczquest.log` (also logcat tag `aczquest`), `result.txt` (status, exit code, fields, seconds of the run) and `shaders/` (unpacked from the APK). Build-time CMake options of this build: `PS2_QUEST` (ON = libmain.so for the APK), `PS2_SOFT_HOOKS` (ON there: hooks by a bit test at each generated function's entry; Windows OFF = the x86 detours), `PS2_VK_HEADLESS_SUPPORT` (ON there: the windowless renderer path), `PS2_QUEST_HOST_INCLUDE` (where the SDL3 / Vulkan headers are copied from, `C:/msys64/ucrt64/include`), `OPENXR_LOADER_DIR` (the unpacked Khronos loader AAR). A PC test build of the same paths: `-DPS2_SOFT_HOOKS=ON -DPS2_VK_HEADLESS_SUPPORT=ON` with `PS2_VK_HEADLESS=1`.

| Variable | Default | Values | Meaning | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ACZQ_COCKPIT_SET` | unset = `cockpits` (the RGBA8 set as before); the Quest default `cockpits_q4` when that folder was pushed (defaults()) | folder name under the data root; `cockpits` | Quest build (rq3_tex 2026-11-11, N1.2, BUGS_RQ R-65): the folder the 3D cockpit models are read from. `cockpits_q4` is `tools/quest/make_cockpits_q4.sh`'s set: format 4 files (`tools/cockpit/cpit_pack.cpp --need 758 --cap 4096 --bc1-auto 46,0.05`) whose textures are BC7 / BC1 with their stored mips, uploaded as they are (no decode, no mips made on the device; the headset's Vulkan has `textureCompressionBC`), each stored from the finest mip level the eye box can sample (the levels above are never read). A model the set lacks is read from `cockpits/`; the LOD side files fit both sets (the same meshes). Back to RGBA8: `ACZQ_COCKPIT_SET=cockpits` in commandline.txt, or `ACZ_VR_COCKPIT_BC=0` (the same file decoded to RGBA8 at load). The log line `cockpit set ...` says how many models came from each folder | @@ACZQ_COCKPIT_SET@@ |
| `ACZQ_DATA` | `/sdcard/ac0oculus` (the files dir if that is not readable) | folder | Quest build: the data root holding `disc.iso` (or the extracted `disc/`), `gen_zero/ps2_image.bin`, `textures/`, `commandline.txt`, `scripts/` | @@ACZQ_DATA@@ |
| `PS2_THREADS` | off (every platform; proposed default of the Quest build after one headset session) | `quest` | The thread budget for the Quest's few slow cores (S4 2026-11-07, ps2_gfxq.c; NOTES_QUEST "S4"): the EE, both graphics stages, the renderer and the audio callback stay the only hot threads. The bulk helpers (terrain bake and its rows, terrain materials, props, water mask, texture pack: pure CPU work) run at the idle level (Windows THREAD_PRIORITY_IDLE, Linux / Android SCHED_IDLE, nice 19 if refused: one `threads: ... helpers at the idle level` line); the map's one-shot jobs (terrain bake, props, water mask, texture pack) one after another on ONE shared helper thread (`threads: helper job NAME: waited N ms in the queue, ran N ms (CPU N ms)`), the materials texture on a thread of its own (map-independent and long: on the shared helper it held the mission's terrain bake 6.0 s); no sub-workers (ACZ_TERRAIN_THREADS 4 -> 1, the materials' 3 extra workers -> 0, PS2_PIPE_WARM_THREADS 4 -> 1); the spin-free thread policy on (PS2_THREAD_POLICY=1) with no texture decode pool helpers (PS2_PERF_TEX_POOL=0); the periodic helpers one level below normal (LOWEST / nice 10) at a lower rate: the canopy cracks every 8 ms instead of 4, the snapshot marker file every 1000 ms instead of 200, the watchdog. Each of those envs, when set, wins. A helper that holds something a hot thread waits for keeps its level: the pipeline warm-up and cache saves and the cockpit loader (Vulkan calls: driver locks -- with them at the idle level the renderer stood 5.0 s at a mission start, 299 fields dropped, on 4 P-cores), the replacement preload, the statistics writer, the nustream loader, the field clock. Unchanged: the guest, the GPU's work, the pacing, the pictures. Cost: at a mission start the realistic-terrain bake and the near-ground materials come later -- 4 P-cores bake 0.43-0.55 s -> 1.4-2.0 s, materials 1.1-1.5 s -> 4.1-4.2 s; 4 E-cores bake 0.8-1.0 s -> 2.8-3.3 s, materials 2.6-2.7 s -> 8.6-10.4 s (the game's own ground until then); a sun-change re-bake in flight likewise. Measured (exclusive, faithful Quest-shaped config, M1 / M3 flights, 150 s each, PS2_CPU_LIMIT 0x55 = one hardware thread of each of 4 P-cores, e4 = 4 E-cores, before / after): every run held 59.9 fields/s; fields dropped 0 in 6 of 7 runs without and 8 of 9 with the mode (the exceptions xrWaitFrame stalls of the OpenXR simulator in flight: 0.28 s, 2 fields / 1.2 s, 72 fields); long game frames (> 25 ms) per 130 s of flight 4P M1 8, 4 -> 4, 3; 4P M3 7, 3 -> 0, 0; 4E M1 1035 -> 865, 914; 4E M3 267 -> 244; 4E M3 with the user's settings 338 -> 300; the worst EE vblank wake in the first 15 s (start-up and mission-start helper bursts) 4P 0.8-27.3 ms -> 0.12-0.17 ms, 4E 10.9 / 16.6 ms -> 3.2 / 0.08 ms (user settings 2.2 -> 8.8 ms, one run each); CPU per field in flight unchanged (4P 12.8-13.2 / 10.3-10.5 ms, 4E 20.2-20.4 / 16.8-16.9 ms: the helpers use ~3 ms of CPU per s in flight). Background thread, the renderer never waits (no free buffer = the picture is dropped and counted); a `qrec: 10 s:` log line (frames in, dropped, encoder busy, copy and encoder ms, game and mic levels in dBFS, file size, free space). `0` = nothing of it runs: no thread, no encoder, no GPU work, the Vulkan device created as before. | `ACZ_AUDIO_SPEAKERS` | `1`, the Quest build only (ENHANCEMENTS > SOUND > QUEST SPEAKERS: ON / SUBTLE / OFF = `1` / `0.5` / `0`); not in the PC build (a PC build with `-DPS2_QUEST_SETTINGS=ON` has it, for tests) | `0`..`1.5` | (rq2_menu 2026-11-09; runtime/src/ps2_spk.c) The speaker profile: the final mix shaped for the Quest 3's own speakers (little below ~120-150 Hz; the user plays on them, not on headphones), on the audio thread right before the device (the WAV taps hear it). 1. Psychoacoustic bass: the band below ACZ_AUDIO_SPEAKERS_XO (mono, Linkwitz-Riley 24 dB/oct) divided by its own envelope (40 ms RMS x sqrt 2) and fed to the Chebyshev polynomials T2 + T3/2, which turn a sine of any level into its exact 2nd and 3rd harmonic, times the envelope again (the harmonics follow the bass's level linearly), band-passed to XO..4 XO and added to both ears at ACZ_AUDIO_SPEAKERS_HARM; 2. the sub-bass below ACZ_AUDIO_SPEAKERS_HP out (12 dB/oct); 3. a low shelf of ACZ_AUDIO_SPEAKERS_SHELF dB below 250 Hz; then a peak limiter at ACZ_AUDIO_SPEAKERS_CEIL (instant attack, 120 ms release, the louder channel). The dry and shaped mixes blended by the strength, smoothed over 20 ms (a page change does not click); 0 = the dry mix bit for bit (checked). Live from the page. CPU (i9-12900K): 0.85-1.08 ms per second of audio in the game (ACZ_DEBUG_SPEAKERS, M1), 0.90-0.94 offline on a 73-s M1 tap (tools/spk_test.c): about 0.1 % of a core. On that tap (M1 cockpit, band RMS dBFS, in / ON / SUBTLE): 0-50 Hz -33.6 / -36.5 / -38.2, 50-120 -29.2 / -28.0 / -29.5, 120-250 -32.7 / -31.0 / -32.1, 250-500 -34.7 / -34.1 / -34.4, above 500 Hz unchanged; peak -2.28 -> -1.00 / -1.71 dBFS, the limiter on 0-14 % of a 10-s window, at most -0.86 dB. Not heard on the headset yet: the user judges ON / SUBTLE / OFF by ear (Since 2026-11-10 the row, the call in ps2_audio.c and ps2_spk.c are compiled only for the Quest: the PC's default objects are as before the row.) | @@ACZ_AUDIO_SPEAKERS@@ |

| `ACZ_SND_SYSTEMS` | `1` | `0`..`2` (level) | Cockpit system sounds (bug #88), synthesised and placed at their spot in the cockpit relative to the head (the spatial mixer's head model; binaural in VR), outside parts muffled in the cockpit view: `switch` -- clicks of the pilot's controls where the game has an event (the weapon switch on the throttle, player+0x1ACB; the target button on the stick, press and release, +0x1AB6; the big map button on the panel, press and release, action 0x10; the master arm once per flight 1.2 s after the pilot gets control); `gear` -- the landing gear (the game has none: a flight whose pilot gets control on the ground (FM+0x236 bit 0) retracts it after lift-off, climbing 15 m above the runway at > 150 kt: door / uplock clunks, the pump, the lock thumps nose then mains, the doors; extends back over that runway slow and descending), the airflow with it down, the wheels on the ground (a roll rising with speed, slab joints under the nose wheel then the mains); `flaps` -- the flap motor and end-stop thuds following the aircraft model's own speed-driven flap channel (player+0x804: down below ~186 kt, up by ~250 kt), a little more airflow with them down; `brake` -- the air brake (L1, flight model +0x408): an actuator stroke, a stop thump at full travel, the airflow with the dynamic pressure. The game has none of these sounds (it beeps the weapon switch, which stays). The continuous layers duck under a loud game and 4 dB under radio speech (ACZ_IMM_DUCK; the take-off balance: ACZ_SND_SYSTEMS_MIX). `0` = off | @@ACZ_SND_SYSTEMS@@ |
| `ACZ_SND_SYSTEMS_MIX` | `2` | `2`, `1` | The take-off mix of the cockpit system sounds: `2` = fewer layers on the take-off roll and at lift-off (under a helmet the runway and the hydraulics are felt more than heard): the wheels' roll 8 dB lower and fading to a quarter between 45 and 80 m/s (the slab joints' knocks keep the rhythm), the flaps' airflow only in the air and 6 dB lower, the gear's airflow 6 dB lower with a gentler wobble (depth 1.2 instead of 2.5), the gear pump 6 dB, the flap motor 4 dB and the air brake actuator 2.5 dB lower; `1` = the first mix (2026-10-23) | @@ACZ_SND_SYSTEMS_MIX@@ |
| `ACZ_SND_SYSTEMS_ITEMS` | `all` | list of `switch`, `gear`, `flaps`, `brake` | Which of the cockpit system sounds play (`gear` includes the wheels on the runway) | @@ACZ_SND_SYSTEMS_ITEMS@@ |
| `ACZ_SND_WARN_PLACE` | on | `0` | The game's own warning and lock tones (radar WARNING (1,3), MISSILE alert (1,4), PULL UP (1,254..256 and 245..247), the seeker's lock-on and locked tones, special-weapon lock) come from the instrument panel (right of centre, below the eye) through the spatial mixer instead of the middle of the head; level, timing and pitch unchanged. Only with binaural sound on (VR) and in the first-person views. `0` = as the game plays them | @@ACZ_SND_WARN_PLACE@@ |
| `ACZ_SND_WARN_BEARING` | `0.3` | `0`..`1` | ACZ_SND_WARN_PLACE: the missile alert leans this fraction of the way from the panel toward the nearest homing missile (the game's own missile list, *(player+0x1A20)) -- a subtle bearing cue; `0` = always the panel | @@ACZ_SND_WARN_BEARING@@ |
| `ACZ_SND_FLYBY` | `1,0.5` (ENHANCEMENTS > SOUND > CLOSE FLY-BYS) | `level[,doppler]`, level `0`..`2` (`0` off) | Close passes of other aircraft (bug #140, zero_flyby.c): every aircraft the game updates (its burner setup 0x1386D0) is followed for 2.1 s; the sound now reaching the head-tracked listener (0x422C18) comes from where the aircraft WAS (the retarded position: the roar arrives after it), with the Doppler ratio of the source's and the listener's velocities (strength `doppler` of the real effect in log pitch; the game's own engines keep 0.25). Per aircraft (the 3 nearest emission points within 600 m) a synthesised voice: the jet's roar (loudest ~140 deg off its nose), the crackle / rip of the exhaust in the rear arc, the inlet's whine in the front arc, the airframe's whoosh within 90 m, a felt rumble within 120 m made audible on small speakers by its harmonics (~140 Hz band); 20 m / distance, air absorption, the canopy's muffling (ACZ_AUDIO_MUFFLE), binaural (ACZ_AUDIO_HRTF), the immersion bus's pilot ducking and -4 dB under radio, a soft limit at -9 dBFS. Only passes: it fades in with the speed relative to the listener (20 -> 80 m/s), so a wingman keeping station adds nothing. Levels (50 ms peak, cockpit): head-on 30 m -12 dBFS, 100 m -21, overtaking at 15 m -4.4 (limited) | @@ACZ_SND_FLYBY@@ |
| `ACZ_SND_FLYBY_TEST` | off | `ahead_m,miss_m,closing_ms,period_s[,first_field]` | [test] A synthetic aircraft on a straight line past the player for ACZ_SND_FLYBY: ahead_m ahead along the levelled view (600), miss_m to the right (30), closing at closing_ms (300), every period_s (8) from first_field (1500) | @@ACZ_SND_FLYBY_TEST@@ |

| `PS2_VU0_ADV_INLINE` | `OFF` | CMake `-DPS2_VU0_ADV_INLINE=ON` / `OFF` | Build time (a CMake option, not read by the game): the VU0 flag pipeline step `ps2_vu0_advance` (runtime/include/ps2_vu0.h) that the generated code calls at 209,608 places. `OFF`: only its "flags pending?" test is inline and the slot loop runs in one cold function, `ps2_vu0_advance_slow` (runtime/src/ps2_vu0.c); same behaviour (3.6 M whole-context comparisons against the old body, 0 differ; GS signatures of replays identical), generated .text 65.6 -> 34.1 MB (ac5.exe text 72.6 -> 41.1 MB), the 62 generated objects build in 85 s instead of 175 s (-j 8; 1,300 -> 510 CPU-s; ps2_code_0013 157 -> 79 s), EE work per field -0.43 ms (-11 %, M3) / -0.28 ms (-7 %, M4). `ON`: the whole loop inlined at every call site, the build before 2026-10-24 (byte-identical generated objects) | @@LINE:CMakeLists.txt:option(PS2_VU0_ADV_INLINE@@ |
| `PS2_GEN_CMODEL_SMALL` | `OFF` | CMake `-DPS2_GEN_CMODEL_SMALL=ON` / `OFF` | Build time (a CMake option): `ON` compiles the generated code (only) with `-mcmodel=small`, so its five extern data symbols (`ps2_pt`, `ps2_trace_ring`, `ps2_trace_pos`, `ps2_loop_ctr`, `ps2_zero_q`, all defined in ac5.exe) are reached RIP-relative instead of through `.refptr` pointers (21,231 pointer loads fewer in ps2_code_0013 alone). On top of the default it measured: generated .text -0.4 %, EE work per field -0.15 ms (M3) / -0.06 ms (M4), under 2 standard errors, build time the same; off until a clear win. Only for data inside the exe: generated code that referenced data in a DLL would fail to link or to load (32-bit pseudo relocation) | @@LINE:CMakeLists.txt:option(PS2_GEN_CMODEL_SMALL@@ |

### Telemetry stream (telem_udp; docs/TELEMETRY.md)

| Variable | Default | Values | Description | Read at |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ACZ_TELEMETRY` | off (ENHANCEMENTS > SYSTEM > TELEMETRY OUTPUT, live, saved as `telemetry_output`; `tools/agents/run_test.sh` and the test scripts set `off`) | `host:port`, `127.0.0.1:20777` (LOCAL), `255.255.255.255:20777` (LAN), `off` | The local telemetry stream for motion rigs, haptics and force-feedback sticks: one UDP datagram per game frame (about 60 a second; in-between frames send nothing) from the renderer thread, on a non-blocking socket that only sends (no listening port, no firewall prompt; a host name is resolved on a thread of its own). Nothing goes to the internet. A value set here holds the menu row | @@ACZ_TELEMETRY@@ |
| `ACZ_TELEMETRY_FORMAT` | `json` (ENHANCEMENTS > SYSTEM > TELEMETRY FORMAT, live, saved as `telemetry_format`) | `json`, `forza`, `forza7` | `json`: one line, under 1200 bytes, every value (docs/TELEMETRY.md). `forza`: the Forza Motorsport "Data Out" Dash packet (331 bytes), for SimHub, SimTools and haptics tools without a plugin; `forza7`: its first 311 bytes, for tools that check the Forza Motorsport 7 length | @@ACZ_TELEMETRY_FORMAT@@ |
| `ACZ_DEBUG_TELEMETRY` | off | N datagrams (`1` = 600) | [debug] Every N datagrams a log line: the rate, the drops, the largest size, the cost per datagram on the renderer thread and per game frame on the EE thread; also the HUD's warning word when it changes | @@ACZ_DEBUG_TELEMETRY@@ |

### Usage statistics (stats_optin; docs/PRIVACY.md)

| Variable | Default | Values | Description | Read at |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ACZ_STATS` | the saved answer (`[privacy] stats`; absent = the question at the title screen; ENHANCEMENTS > SYSTEM > SEND USAGE STATISTICS; `tools/agents/run_test.sh` and the test scripts set `0`) | `0`, `1`, `ask` | `0`: no question, nothing written or sent. `1`: on without the question (the answer in the file is left alone; a random id for this run if there is none). Anything else, or unset: the saved answer, or the question. Opt-in usage statistics to the project's PostHog: one `session` event per session, one `crash` event per crash report, each with the build's `version` (ps2_version_line). Without a key (no `posthog.secret` at configure time) there is no question and the menu reads NOT AVAILABLE IN THIS BUILD | @@ACZ_STATS@@ |
| `ACZ_STATS_DRY` | off | `1` | Logs every document instead of sending it, and drops the pending file as if sent | @@ACZ_STATS_DRY@@ |
| `ACZ_DEBUG_STATS` | off | `1` | [debug] Logs each document when it is written and when it is sent (never the project token) | @@ACZ_DEBUG_STATS@@ |
| `ACZ_STATS_EVERY` | `600` | seconds | How often the running session's document is saved to `stats/pending_<stamp>.json` beside the exe, so a crash loses little | @@ACZ_STATS_EVERY@@ |
| `ACZ_STATS_GEOIP` | off | `1` | Leaves `$ip` and `$geoip_disable` out of the documents, so PostHog's GeoIP adds the location (by default down to the city: its project settings decide). Off: the document says `$ip` 0.0.0.0, and the stored event has no real address and no location. If you ship this on, change docs/PRIVACY.md and turn on the project's "Discard client IP data" | @@ACZ_STATS_GEOIP@@ |
| `ACZ_STATS_KEY` | from `posthog.secret` at configure time | a project token | Another PostHog project's write-only token, or a dummy for `ACZ_STATS_DRY` test runs; never logged | @@ACZ_STATS_KEY@@ |
| `ACZ_STATS_REGION` | from `posthog.secret`'s second line, else `eu` | `eu`, `us` | PostHog's region: `eu.i.posthog.com` or `us.i.posthog.com` | @@ACZ_STATS_REGION@@ |
| `ACZ_STATS_HOST` | off | a host name or address | [test only] Sends there instead of PostHog (an address that answers nothing, to measure the 2 s limit at the exit) | @@ACZ_STATS_HOST@@ |
| `ACZ_STATS_TEST` | off | `1` | [test only] Adds `test: true` to every document, so that a real test event can be told apart | @@ACZ_STATS_TEST@@ |

### GS capture (F6, gsreplay) and state snapshots (F8)

| Variable | Default | Values | Meaning | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PS2_CAP_MAX_MB` | `16384` | MB | Size limit of a GS capture file | @@PS2_CAP_MAX_MB@@ |
| `PS2_CAP_DICT_SLOTS` | `8192` | count (rounded to a power of two) | Capture dedup dictionary slots | @@PS2_CAP_DICT_SLOTS@@ |
| `PS2_CAP_DICT_MIN` | `2048` | bytes | Smallest payload the capture dictionary dedups | @@PS2_CAP_DICT_MIN@@ |
| `PS2_CAP_DICT_MAX` | 2 MB | bytes | Largest payload the capture dictionary dedups | @@PS2_CAP_DICT_MAX@@ |
| `PS2_CAP_DICT_MB` | `256` | MB | Memory budget of the capture dictionary | @@PS2_CAP_DICT_MB@@ |
| `PS2_CAP_NORAM` | off | any | Leave the 32 MB RAM image out of the capture | @@PS2_CAP_NORAM@@ |
| `PS2_REPLAY_ASYNC` | off | `1` | [test] gsreplay sends the capture's records through the graphics queue (ps2_gfxq.c) as the game's EE does -- two stages, or one worker with PS2_GFX_SPLIT=0 -- with a drain after every field, so statistics and PS2_GS_SIG signatures stay deterministic (`replay_ab.sh` in a private script compares the three ways). Only this way do VIF chunks go through ps2_vif_transfer as in the game (the synchronous replay feeds VIF data a quadword at a time through ps2_vif_fifo). Each pass then prints `thread CPU per field` of the worker (stage 1), stage 2 and the replay thread (ov_vif 2026-10-25); the replay thread is profiled as `ee` (PS2_PROFILE_HOST=gfx = the worker, gfx2 = stage 2) | @@PS2_REPLAY_ASYNC@@ |
| `PS2_REPLAY_VIF_AB` | off | `1` | [test] gsreplay: PS2_PERF_VIF_FAST on in the odd passes and off in the even ones (with `--loop 2N`): the same fields both ways in one process, alternating; compare the passes' `thread CPU per field`, the phase profile (`--bench`, PS2_PROFILE_PHASES=1: the VIF walker row is stage 1's VIF work with PS2_GFX_SPLIT) and the PS2_GS_SIG signatures (a private script rpab.sh, rpabsum.py) | @@PS2_REPLAY_VIF_AB@@ |
| `PS2_REPLAY_TEX_AB` | off | `1` | [test] gsreplay: the texture switches named in PS2_PERF_TEX_AB_FLIP as configured in the odd passes (block A) and flipped in the even ones (B), with `--loop 2N`: the same fields both ways in one process; with PS2_TEX_STREAM_LOG (any value) each pass writes its tex-stream lines (stage 2's thread cycles per field, the zones; analysis tools/perf/tsl_pairs.py LOG --from 0, or a private script rpab.sh / tools/rpab_sum.py). Use PS2_REPLAY_ASYNC=1, and no PS2_GS_SIG in timing passes (it adds ~8 ms a field) | @@PS2_REPLAY_TEX_AB@@ |
| `PS2_REPLAY_HIDDEN` | off | `1` | [test] gsreplay without a visible window | @@PS2_REPLAY_HIDDEN@@ |
| `PS2_GS_SIG` | off | `1` | [test] A `gs-sig:` line per field: hashes of every GS register write, of GS memory at the field's end and of every VU1 activation's inputs (start, TOP, ITOP, registers, data memory), so two replays of one capture can be compared field by field | @@PS2_GS_SIG@@ |
| `PS2_SNAP_NORAM` | off | any | State snapshot without the RAM dump | @@PS2_SNAP_NORAM@@ |
| `PS2_SNAP_NOCHUNK` | off | any | State snapshot without `machine.bin` | @@PS2_SNAP_NOCHUNK@@ |
| `PS2_SNAP_NOKEY` | off | any | Do not watch for a `snap.on` file as a snapshot trigger | @@PS2_SNAP_NOKEY@@ |

### External variables

Not read by the runtime's own code, but set by it or by the launcher, or read by the Python tools.

| Variable | Default | Values | Meaning | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ACZ_DISC` | none | path to an ISO image or to a folder with the disc's files | The disc for `play_zero_vr.sh`, `bench_flat.sh`, `run_zero_mission.sh`, `run_zero_soak.sh` and `sweep_missions.sh`; without either they stop with a message (night_repo 2026-11-04) | @@LINE:play_zero_vr.sh:ISO=${ACZ_DISC:-@@ |
| `ACZ_UCRT64_BIN` | `/c/msys64/ucrt64/bin` | folder | Build time: the folder of MSYS2's compilers that the cockpit build scripts (for `cpit_bake`) and `tools/textures/build_xbrz.sh` put first on PATH (night_repo 2026-11-04) | @@LINE:tools/cockpit/build_f15c.sh:ACZ_UCRT64_BIN@@ |
| `SDL_JOYSTICK_ALLOW_BACKGROUND_EVENTS` | SDL default (off) | `1` | SDL keeps reading the gamepad while the window is unfocused; `play_zero_vr.sh` sets 1 | @@LINE:play_zero_vr.sh:export SDL_JOYSTICK_ALLOW_BACKGROUND_EVENTS@@ |
| `ACZ_PAD_LAYOUT` | F4 / ENHANCEMENTS setting (`[input] pad_layout`; classic, modern with ACZ_MENU_SETTINGS=1 while the file has none) | `modern`, `classic` | Controller layout for the session: `modern` = the modern layout (RT/LT = R1/L1 analog throttle up/down, RB/LB = R2/L2 yaw, both = autopilot; the rest as classic), `classic` = the F4 bindings; not saved unless changed in F4 (launcher words `modern` / `classic`; the desktop shortcuts use modern) | @@ACZ_PAD_LAYOUT@@ |

The F4 settings menu also reads `PS2_ASPECT`, `PS2_PRESENT_MODE`, `PS2_FPS_CAP`, `PS2_UPSCALE`, `PS2_NO_MIP` and `PS2_PAD_DEADZONE`, only to warn that an environment variable overrides the setting shown (`runtime/src/ps2_ui.cpp`).
